title: 3.0 RC3 | No bg received while values in xdrip tab
body:
This is the second time I experience this issue, using FSL2/xDrip+/ and AAPS 3.0 Rc3. Samsung Galaxy S9
AAPS is stating the last received BG is 149 minutes ago, while in de xDrip tab it shows the BG values like it should.
After a restart of AAPS the values show up in the main screen again.
